title: Little Grey on the Street
subtitle: Five Years as a Stray
description: Little Grey is a dusty white cat. Over five years on the street he meets dogs, geese, people with nets, kind people, the keeper of a fish mountain — and also cages, something tight around his neck, a day the wind lifted the street, and one door he cannot read.

states.label: Charm
states.description: The ability to attract humans, including outer cleanliness and inner temperament

states.label: Health
states.description: Can be negative; while it is negative, every month costs that many months of lifespan (at -3 you lose 3 months each month)

states.label: Dried Fish
states.description: Food store; fish you hand over offset the same amount of health loss

states.label: Friendliness
states.description: How willing you are to trust humans; it decides whether anyone keeps you in the end

characters.name: The Young Person With a Net
The Person in the White Coat
The Man in the Back Alley
The Man at the Alley Mouth

scenes.title: The First Sound in the Box
scenes.description: Little Grey was born in a cardboard box behind a convenience store. His fur is white, but dust makes him look gray.

hide.text: You curl up, and the box becomes a small mountain.

explore.text: You touch the ground; the world is bigger than the box.

scenes.title: Under the Big Thing in the Rain
scenes.description: Rain turns the street into one bright sheet. You slip under a big thing while water streams past its four round feet.

dry.text: The big thing blocks most of the rain. You curl up and sleep until it stops.

mud.text: Mud covers your white fur, making you look even less like a house cat.

call.text: The rain is loud, but you call anyway.

scenes.title: The Keeper of the Fish Mountain
scenes.description: A mountain of fish is piled on the step, and a person in an apron guards it. An older cat sits under the fish mountain, showing how to sit upright, look up and meow softly.

enemy.name: The Keeper of the Fish Mountain

actions.name: Observe the older cat
actions.hint: Learn how it sits and looks at people

wait.text: You sit quietly, and she does not shoo you away. You remember this.

observe.text: You learn a little about sitting upright, looking at humans, and meowing softly.

steal.text: You grab the fish and run, your tail turning before your body. She knows it was you.

scenes.title: Big Yellow's Territory
scenes.description: Big Yellow guards the big bins by the crossing. He will chase you on sight.

success.text: You cut two corners; Big Yellow's nose hits the bricks.

failure.text: Big Yellow chases you half a street. You squeeze through a fence and pant.

success.text: You arch your back like a bridge, and Big Yellow stops.

failure.text: You are bumped aside and tumble into the grass.

tiers.text: You drop the dried fish at his feet, and he lowers his nose to it. You walk past behind him, and neither of you gets hurt.
You do not have two scraps to offer. He still snaps at you, but he lets go quickly and the bite is shallow.

scenes.title: White Tyrant's Riverbank
scenes.description: The wild goose White Tyrant rules the riverbank. Her neck is longer than your front legs.

success.text: You circle behind the riverbank; White Tyrant only sees your tail.

failure.text: You are not fast enough, and White Tyrant pecks you twice.

success.text: You pin her wing, and White Tyrant steps back.

failure.text: You are swept down by her wing, and your chest hurts for a long time.

success.text: You dash under her wing, and the wind pushes you up the bank.

failure.text: Her wing sweeps you, and you roll twice.

scenes.title: The Person With a Net
scenes.description: A young person stands at the mouth of the alley with a net. Their movements are steady, and they keep coming closer.

enemy.name: The Young Person With a Net

success.text: You hide against its warm belly, and the net misses.

failure.text: The net touches your back, and you struggle before slipping out.

success.text: You pass between the net and wall like a white line.

failure.text: The net brushes your ear, and you are held for a moment.

accept.text: The worker places you in a carrier, moving gently. You wake up back on your own corner, a little cleaner than before.

scenes.title: The Kid Who Crouches Down
scenes.description: A little girl crouches at the corner with half a dried fish in her palm.

approach.text: She puts the dried fish on the ground and steps back for you. It is a full meal.

rub.text: She pets your head, and your body relaxes a little. This time you do not pull away.

leave.text: You back against the wall, and she does not follow.

scenes.title: The Person in the White Coat
scenes.description: A person in a white coat rests a hand on your back. The room smells sharp and clean.

enemy.name: The Person in the White Coat

treat.text: She dabs something cool on your wounds and sets out a bowl of water. You let her touch the back of your neck.

hide.text: You hide under the chair, and she places a little cool pack beside you.

struggle.text: You bite her hand once; she stops and waits for you to calm down.

scenes.title: The Bath and the Band Around the Neck
scenes.description: The girl takes you home for a bath and puts a band around your neck.

actions.name: Accept the band
actions.hint: She says to keep it on

bath.text: The water is warm, and your white fur finally shows. You fall asleep in human hands for the first time.

collar.text: The band is light, and its little bell rings only once. The girl says: keep it on, don't lose it.

resist.text: You scratch her once and jump out the window, leaving the band on the table.

scenes.title: The Kid With a Stick
scenes.description: A little boy with a stick sees you and starts chasing.

success.text: You grab the stick and scare him off. His crying follows you for two blocks.

failure.text: The stick sweeps your side, and you bolt away with puffed fur.

success.text: You dash behind the flower bed, and he cannot catch you.

failure.text: He catches up and throws a small stone that hits your hind leg.

success.text: You slip along the wall, and he does not see you.

failure.text: You step on a branch, and the sound brings him over.

scenes.title: The Move the Old Cat Shows You
scenes.description: Old Orange takes you to the iron fence, flattens himself, angles his shoulders, slips through the narrowest gap, and looks back at you.

follow.text: You get stuck the first time, then angle your shoulders through the second time. You practise the move all afternoon.

watch.text: You see how he lowers his body at an angle, and you try the same with your own shoulders.

ignore.text: You take a long detour and learn nothing.

scenes.title: Old Orange Pulls Himself Up the Wall
scenes.description: Old Orange springs up, hooks his front paws over the wall, and pulls his whole body up. He stands there a moment, then drops back down in front of you and tips his chin, waiting for you to try.

actions.name: Try a couple
actions.hint: Stay up as long as you can

train.text: You practise until your paws ache. On the way back you feel you can press down heavier things than before.

try.text: You try twice, and your front paws hold on a little better than before.

ignore.text: You walk along the wall and do not stop.

scenes.title: The Bag That Smells of Fish
scenes.description: A bag near the big bins smells like fish. It smells very good.

sniff.text: You smell fish, with something sharp underneath.

bite.text: You swallow a soft little piece. It sticks in your stomach and hurts.

avoid.text: You leave it alone and look for safer water.

scenes.title: The Thing Leaning Against the Wall
scenes.description: Something bright stands against the wall. A cat exactly like you is staring back out of it.

stare.text: You stare for a long time, then look down and groom your fur.

pounce.text: Your nose bumps into something cold and hard, and the other cat bumps into it too.

walk.text: You walk past it without looking back.

scenes.title: A Small Bunch of Round Things
scenes.description: Someone left a small bunch of round things on the step. They smell very sweet.

actions.name: Walk away
actions.hint: Do not eat what people leave

eat.text: That night your belly cramps you into a ball, and the next day you are still sick.

sniff.text: Very sweet, but you only remember the smell.

leave.text: You walk around the step and look for water you know.

scenes.title: The White Bowl at the Door
scenes.description: Someone left a bowl of something white and smooth at their door. It smells rich.

drink.text: The milk is rich. At midnight your belly starts rumbling, and the next day leaves you weak.

sip.text: You only take a few licks. Your belly complains a little, then settles.

leave.text: You go and drink from the puddle by the wall instead.

scenes.title: The Yellow Board in the Corner
scenes.description: A yellow board sits in the corner with a few crumbs on it. A sticky smell comes off it.

step.text: All four paws stick fast. You tear out a layer of fur to get free, and your pads ache for days.

touch.text: One paw sticks. You shake it loose after a long while, leaving a tuft of fur behind.

avoid.text: You remember that smell. From then on you always walk around that corner.

scenes.title: The Day the Wind Lifted the Whole Street
scenes.description: The wind lifts everything on the street and the big signs on the walls rattle. The rain falls sideways.

stairwell.text: There is no wind inside the building. You shake off the water and sleep a whole night for once.

under-car.text: Water pours in past its round feet. You spend the night half in cold water, and by morning your paws are numb.

run.text: A sheet of tin flies past your back, and you run a long time in the wind before you stop.

scenes.title: The Coldest Winter
scenes.description: The pipes are frozen and it is too cold to move. Your store of dried fish is in your hiding place.

tiers.text: You eat the whole year's store of dried fish and lean against the warm pipe to outlast the coldest days.
There is not enough in your hiding place. You just have to go hungry and endure it.

scenes.title: The Person Who Leaves Things and Walks Away
scenes.description: A person whose face you cannot see sets down a bowl, steps back, and does not come closer. There is leftover rice in it.

tiers.text: He waits until you finish, comes back the next day, and brings an old blanket. Someone has been looking after the cats on this street.
Before you get close, he stands up and walks away. The bowl goes with him.

watch.text: He waits a long time, then leaves the bowl and goes. You only go over once he is far away.

hide.text: You shrink back behind the wall. The footsteps fade quickly.

scenes.title: The Bubbling Bottle on the Pavement
scenes.description: A half-finished sweet drink lies on the pavement, still fizzing. It smells sweet.

lick.text: The bubbles burst on your tongue. You hiccup, and the gas sits in your stomach for hours.

paw.text: The bottle tips over and the sweet water runs into the drain. You smell it for a long time.

leave.text: You remember one thing: do not drink water that bubbles.

scenes.title: The Place with Noise on Both Sides
scenes.description: You are in the middle of the wide hard ground, and the noise is closing in from both sides.

success.text: You wait for the small silence between two rushes of noise and cross in a few steps.

failure.text: You wait too long; a loud sound chases you and you roll to the far side right beside a round foot.

success.text: You dash across low to the ground, the wind pressing your whiskers down.

failure.text: A round foot clips your hind leg and you lie at the edge for a long time before you can stand.

back.text: You back up to the wall you came from. This ground can wait until tomorrow.

scenes.title: The Metal Box That Blows Warm Air
scenes.description: The metal box on the wall keeps buzzing and blows out warm air. The concrete step under it is warm too.

curl.text: The warm air pushes your fur one way, and you sleep the whole afternoon.

climb.text: The fan blade catches your paw. You jump down with a stinging pad.

leave.text: You walk out from under the metal box and look for somewhere quieter.

scenes.title: The Round Cover Under the Water
scenes.description: The rain has stopped. A shallow sheet of water sits on the wide hard ground with a round iron cover underneath. You cannot tell how deep it is.

step.text: Your front leg goes through and the whole cat drops into the cold water. You climb out soaked and shiver for a long time.

paw.text: Your paw finds the cover solid under the water, and you cross on top of it.

around.text: You go around on a dry patch instead. A few more steps, but your fur stays dry.

scenes.title: Those Few Grains in the Corner
scenes.description: A few grains lie in the corner. They smell of grain, with something sweet and wrong underneath.

eat.text: Two hours later your legs start trembling. You throw up everything and twitch through the whole night.

sniff.text: You pick out the wrongness under the smell, remember it, and never touch anything like it again.

leave.text: You turn away and go looking for something else to eat.

scenes.title: Red Petals All Over the Ground
scenes.description: It is busy at the mouth of the alley. Red petals and little paper pieces cover the ground, and children are stamping on them.

chase.text: You leap at the red pieces, and a little girl laughs so hard she crouches down.

sit.text: You sit among the petals, and someone puts a sweet down beside you. You eat it, and your paws feel warm.

leave.text: You slip around the edge of the crowd while the bangs keep going.

scenes.title: The Things Wriggling on the Wet Ground
scenes.description: The rain has just stopped. Thin wriggling things lie all over the ground, and they curl up when you touch them.

actions.name: Eat one
actions.hint: It moves, but it is food

eat.text: Slippery mouthfuls; you eat a few and your belly settles.

play.text: You bat at them for a long time while they curl into balls, leaving the edge of the puddle churned up.

leave.text: You walk past the puddle and go looking for something more filling.

scenes.title: The Big Noisy Thing That Comes Every Morning
scenes.description: At dawn a very big thing stops beside the big bins. It keeps making noise, and someone is tipping things into it.

actions.name: Jump on the big bin beside it
actions.hint: See what is happening up there

wait.text: It rattles for a while and drives off. You wait for quiet before going to look.

chase.text: Its round feet throw up water and soak one whole side of you.

success.text: You land neatly on the lid, watch it get emptied, jump down, and find two pieces of meat.

failure.text: The lid is slippery. You fall in, get shaken out, and land hard on the ground.

scenes.title: The Narrow Path Along the Outside of the Building
scenes.description: A very narrow edge runs along the outside of a building, straight to the next one. Concrete lies below.

actions.name: Walk along the edge
actions.hint: It saves a long way round

actions.name: Go back the way you came

success.text: Not one paw slips, and a few dozen steps take you across.

failure.text: A hind paw slips. You hang off the edge and only climb back up by hauling with your front paws.

roof.text: You take a long way round over the roof slope. Tiring, but steady.

back.text: You back to the safe side and take the steps below instead.

scenes.title: The Warmest Stone on the Path
scenes.description: The afternoon sun has warmed a stone slab by the path. No other cat has found this spot yet.

sleep.text: You sleep on your back. When you wake it is almost dark and your body is still warm.

rest.text: You rest a little with your ears on the street, and stand up lighter than before.

leave.text: You walk across the slab, your tail swinging through the sun.

scenes.title: The Soft Thing by the Wall
scenes.description: A soft thing has appeared at the foot of the wall, sun-warmed and smelling of clean dust.

sleep.text: You do not dream. You sleep until morning, and the ache leaves your bones.

claw.text: Tufts of stuffing fly up, and you bat them around for a while.

leave.text: You leave it alone. The next day the rain soaks it through.

scenes.title: The Big Cat on the Warm Stone
scenes.description: A fat tabby has taken the warm stone you always sleep on. Its tail hangs over the edge, and it watches you.

success.text: You arch first; it blinks first. The tabby climbs down slowly and walks off.

failure.text: One swat pins you to the ground. Your ears stay hot for a long time.

wait.text: It sleeps until the sun tilts, then leaves. A little warmth is still left in the stone.

leave.text: The new corner blocks the wind, but the sun never reaches it.

scenes.title: The Long Tail by the Wall
scenes.description: At night a slender shadow slips out of a hole in the wall with half a fish in its mouth. It sees you and does not let go.

success.text: It drops the fish and slips back into the hole. You are bigger; that is the whole argument.

failure.text: It bites you and scrambles over the wall. The half fish is its now.

hiss.text: You stare each other down. It grips the fish tighter and slips away along the other wall.

pass.text: Your whiskers brush its tail. Neither of you stops.

scenes.title: The Big Rat at the Pipe Mouth
scenes.description: A small pile of fish heads is drying by the pipe mouth at the foot of the wall. A rat bigger than your paw guards it, whiskers twitching first.

actions.name: Pounce
actions.hint: Chase it back into the pipe

success.text: You pin its tail; it squeals and darts back into the pipe. The fish heads are yours.

failure.text: It sinks its teeth into your paw. Shaking it off, you knock the whole pile over.

snatch.text: You grab one and leap clear. It squeaks twice behind you, but does not follow.

leave.text: The smell of fish heads follows you half a street, then fades.

scenes.title: The Bowl of Little Round Pieces by the Door
scenes.description: A shallow bowl sits by someone's door, full of little round pieces that smell of grain and fish.

eat.text: The little pieces crunch, and halfway through you want water.

wait.text: A person with a bag comes by and fills the bowl, and does not shoo you away.

sniff.text: The smell is neat, not like anything found in the alley. You walk on.

scenes.title: Water Still Dripping from the Eave
scenes.description: The rain has stopped, and drops fall one by one from the eave, landing right on the stone below.

drink.text: Drop by drop, you catch the water on your tongue until half full.

shake.text: Drops fly off your fur and flash once in the dusk.

leave.text: The stone grows brighter with every drop. You do not look back.

scenes.title: The Coat in the Sun
scenes.description: A windless patch of sun lies along the wall. A few knots have worked their way into your coat.

groom.text: Once the knots give way, your pale fur fluffs up again. Passersby slow for half a step.

scratch.text: Two knots become three. You pretend not to notice.

nap.text: The sun bakes your back warm, and you sleep until the shadow climbs the wall.

scenes.title: Fish Bones in a Torn Bag
scenes.description: A torn bag in the corner smells of fish. A little meat still hangs on the bones.

lick.text: You lick the scraps off carefully, and they go down clean.

tear.text: A shard of bone catches in your mouth, and you shake your head for a long time.

pass.text: The bag stays where it is. Whoever wants it can have it.

scenes.title: Orange Shadows in the Water
scenes.description: The pond is shallow, and orange shadows circle just beneath the surface.

tiers.text: Your paw moves faster than the splash. One shadow lands on the bank.
The splash hits your face. The shadows scatter, then gather again one circle out.

watch.text: You watch them circle again and again, until the sun turns the water to gold.

walk.text: The wind off the water is cooler than the alley. You walk the whole bank slowly.

scenes.title: The Sticky Patch on the Ground
scenes.description: A small round sticky patch on the ground shines in the sun.

step.text: It sticks to your pads and fur. You lick at it all the way home, and it only gets stickier.

poke.text: It grabs one paw. It takes seven shakes to get free.

around.text: You step around it. It still shines there as if nothing happened.

scenes.title: Another Cat Has the Spot
scenes.description: It starts to rain again. Only one dry patch is left under the eave, and a black cat with yellow eyes is already lying there.

actions.name: Lie down beside it
actions.hint: There is room if you squeeze

share.text: It does not move. The rain covers both cats in the same dry patch.

stare.text: It stares back and curls its tail a little tighter. The spot does not grow.

go.text: Rain taps your back, and you walk as fast as always.

scenes.title: The Narrow Wall Old Orange Walks
scenes.description: Old Orange walks the length of a narrow wall, drops down, and looks back at you.

drill.text: On the third length your paws land without a sound. Old Orange does not look back again.

watch.text: You memorize, one by one, the places its paws land.

leave.text: The narrow wall grows thinner in your sight. You turn and go elsewhere.

scenes.title: The Crackling Alley Mouth
scenes.description: Red scraps cover half the alley, and the bangs come one burst after another.

hide.text: The crack is exactly one cat wide. The bangs pass back and forth outside it.

dash.text: You shoot across low, one paw in the red scraps, and the next bang knocks you back to the wall.

watch.text: From half a street away you watch the red scraps fall. By the time the sound reaches you, it is dull.

scenes.title: The Cage at the End of the Alley
scenes.description: A man guards the back alley with a cage beside his foot. He does not step aside.

enemy.name: The Man in the Back Alley

success.text: Your claws cross the back of his hand, and the cage drops.

failure.text: You do not have enough strength. The cage closes, and you go to the Cat Star.

success.text: You dash past his trouser leg, leaving the wind behind.

failure.text: You cannot escape. The cage closes, and you go to the Cat Star.

success.text: You hide in the box; he only smells you.

failure.text: He kicks the box over. The cage closes, and you go to the Cat Star.

scenes.title: The Thing Tight Around Your Neck
scenes.description: Something thin is caught around your neck. The more you struggle, the tighter it pulls.

struggle.text: It digs into your fur and you can barely breathe.

freeze.text: Once you stop, it stops tightening.

help.text: A passerby crouches down and slowly cuts it away. Once it drops, nothing else is left on you.

scenes.title: The Person Who Opens the Door
scenes.description: A woman opens the door a crack, and light falls in front of your paws. You cannot smell what is inside the room.

enemy.name: The Person Who Opens the Door

actions.name: Turn away
actions.hint: The street is not done with you

tiers.text: She crouches and lets you sniff her fingers first. The floor is warm, and the door closes behind you — you never have to live outside again.
You flatten yourself and creep along the wall. She looks at your matted fur, then at the way you hug the wall, and quietly closes the door.

leave.text: You step back and turn into the night. The light closes slowly behind you.

scenes.title: The Man Blocking the Alley
scenes.description: He stands at the mouth of the alley with a sack in his hand. He does not step aside, and he says nothing.

enemy.name: The Man at the Alley Mouth

success.text: Your claws cross the back of his hand, and the sack drops.

failure.text: You do not have enough strength. The sack is tied shut, and you go to the Cat Star.

success.text: You dash past his trouser leg, leaving the wind behind.

failure.text: You cannot escape. The sack is tied shut, and you go to the Cat Star.

endings.title: Cat Martial God · One Paw, Thunder
endings.description: One paw falls, and the man at the alley mouth turns to ash. The street falls silent, and the Cat Martial God sits on the roof watching the moon.

endings.title: Stray No More
endings.description: You sleep on your back on the bed, belly to the ceiling. No one sends you out again.

realPhotos.title: Hidden page: a real cat
realPhotos.caption: This is a real cat named Tuntun — carried home in a bag first, and sleeping like this on the bed later.

endings.title: King of the Alley
endings.description: You have beaten nearly every rival on this street. You and Old Orange split the street, one throne on each side of the big bins.

endings.title: Old Grey on the Street
endings.description: You lived your whole life on the same street. The big bins, the eaves, the space under big things — you knew them all. Nobody ever gave you a name, but every cat on this street knew you. You lived {age} months. After one last winter you did not get up again — not from illness this time, just from age.

endings.title: Did Not Last the Winter
endings.description: The illness never really left you. On one very cold morning you curled into a ball in a cardboard box beside the warm pipe and did not get up again. You lived only {age} months. That is how it goes for many cats on this street.

endings.title: The Cat Star
endings.description: The sack opens later. There is no cat inside, only very soft light.

catalog.headline: Five years, one dusty white cat.
catalog.description: Thirty quarters: a box, a rainy night, dogs and geese, people with nets, kind people — plus something bright that shows a cat, small round fruit, a white bowl, a yellow board, the day the wind lifted the street, the coldest winter and the warmest stone. The last quarters are the man in the back alley, the thing around your neck, that door, and the man at the alley mouth.
catalog.cardDescription: Strength, agility, charm, friendliness, health, dried fish, and lifespan decide your ending.

keepsakes.title: The Cat Martial God on the Roof
keepsakes.story: One paw falls, the alley falls quiet — and he becomes the legend of this street.

keepsakes.title: Little Grey in the Blanket
keepsakes.story: The blanket is warm. He sleeps on his back until noon, and no one sends him out again.

keepsakes.title: The King on the Big Bin
keepsakes.story: The street is split in two, and he sits on the throne on the left side.

keepsakes.title: The Cat Under the Lamp Post
keepsakes.story: Nobody knows his name, but he knows every eave in the neighbourhood.

keepsakes.title: Warm Light in the Box
keepsakes.story: The illness took him, but that cardboard box stayed warm.

keepsakes.title: The Light on the Cat Star
keepsakes.story: The sack opens, and there is no cat inside — only a small, very soft light.
